name: B10-0385/2026 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening global health resilience in partner countries
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to treat health in poorer partner countries as a strategic priority, not just aid. It asks for sustained public funding despite recent cuts, stronger health systems, local production of medicines and vaccines, and more support for health workers. It also wants action on gender gaps in health, climate effects on disease, misleading health information, and cooperation through the World Health Organization. The text is a set of recommendations; it does not itself change any law or budget.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission for a roadmap, funding plans and accountability rules.
- **Who it affects:** People in partner countries, health workers, and EU aid and research budgets.
- **What happens next:** The Commission is asked to report back to Parliament and Council regularly.
